review_notes: lo tsar follows the selected qere reading to him; the ASV margin preserves the alternative he was no adversary, which is a textual matter and not realigned here.

variant_decisions.evidence: Qere ל֣וֹ is the preposition with 3ms suffix, “to him” (R/Sp3ms); ketiv לא is the negative “not” (Tn, Strong 3808), before צָ֗ר. ASV’s text, “In all their affliction he was afflicted”, reads the qere, and its footnote on this verse, “Another reading is, In all their adversity he was no adversary”, names the ketiv as the reading not adopted. The mapped note distinguishes them explicitly.
